about: The Works (assemble_works.py; plan 34 part 1 "A. The Works"): where things are, Blender space (x, y, z), metres; three.js is (x, z, -y). x across the lane (No. 1 at minus x, always on the left looking up the lane), y up the lane from its mouth, z up.

decisions.w1_w2_camera_places: Settled with the shot checker (round 3), four ways: (A) the pavement's middle, 1.1 m from the house fronts, gates 7 m apart: 12 problems in W1 and 4 in W2, the lines meeting on the gate (0.004 away), nothing past the phone buttons; (B) gates moved 0.9 m toward the lane's middle, camera in line with the outer pier: 15 and 5, the queue's nearest man past 0.95 across; (C) gates moved 0.5 m: 15 and 5, the same, the lantern hidden; (D) the first plan's spot in line with the outer pier, 0.2 m from the house fronts: inside the bank's bay window, everything hidden. Kept: (A).
decisions.w4_camera: in line with No. 2's inner hinge post: from the outer one the eight men stood one behind another and read as one
decisions.lane_head_corners: the drums stand in a flagged corner in front of each outer pier: along the house fronts' line they hid the brazier from W1
decisions.men_shadows: the men cast no long shadows (each has a small soft patch at his feet), so a state picture swaps only the men and their feet (round 2: long shadows made the swap area 42% of the frame)
decisions.round_4: W1 and W2 stand 0.4 m toward the kerb from the pavement's middle (x -3.7 and 3.7): the nearest house front fills less of the frame's side and the lane head's corner shows. W3's eye is 5.6 m above the lane (the end terrace on a raised footway 1 m up), so the queue's tail, 6 m in front of W1's composed spot, reaches about 0.70 down in W3. No. 1's brazier stands against the outer pier with the stooped man at its front-left, the PETROL and DIESEL drums to its right with both words whole from W1; the queue stands along the kerb to the right of them, 1.1 m apart. No. 2's drums stand by its outer pier with a clear gap, both words whole from W2. The handcart is on the right pavement in W3's bottom third. No. 1's yard is in a faint cool light (its gate's bars show against it); a warm beam from No. 2's yard lies along the pavement in W2; one curtained window glows on each gate view's quiet side.
decisions.round_5: W1 and W2 stand 3 m nearer the gates (plate spot 10.0 m and composed spot 8.8 m from the works wall, the slide still 1.2 m). The waiting men stand gathered in front of each shut gate, a loose crowd two deep, backs to the lane, with a thin rim of light from the yard and the gate lamp; at No. 1 the brazier stands against the right gate leaf with the stooped man at it, and the PETROL and DIESEL drums stand in front of the crowd's left end (at No. 2 its right end), so no man stands between them and the gate views or W3 (against the dividing wall, as round 4's check asked, they would lie past 0.93 across in W1). The gate lamps hang on the outer piers' inner faces and light only the gates, chains, boards, men and ground. People at work show in both lit doorways (No. 1's from "go"). No. 1's looms are chest-high with big driving wheels and cloth; both far walls are broken up. The pop-up crates stand in the gateway's middle; the handcart, loaded with crates, at the right pavement's kerb.

w3.stands_on: the end house's upstairs floor (the end terrace stands on a raised footway 1 m above the street; the eye 5.6 m above the lane's pavements)
w3.about: both gates, from the end house's upstairs window across the cross street

w1.about: No. 1's shut gate with the waiting men gathered in front of it

w2.about: No. 2's open gate with nobody waiting

w4.about: No. 2's gate from inside its yard, looking out down the lane

workers.about: the people at work inside each lit doorway (painted into the plates; not in the film's set): No. 2's in every No. 2 plate (the first only when slowed), No. 1's in the working and "men gone" helper plates

machines.about: the middle of the machines seen through each doorway, for the pages' labels (Blender x, y, z)

quiet.about: No. 1 quiet (7 men waiting, windows dark, gate shut and chained), No. 2 flat out (all lit, gate wide open, two people at work in its doorway)

working.about: No. 1 working (the men gone in, two of them at its looms, every window lit, cart doors open, gate open, the crates popped up in its gateway), No. 2 flat out

men gone.about: No. 1 the moment after "go" (the men gone in, two of them at its looms, the gate open, its cart doors open and doorway lit, its windows still dark), No. 2 flat out

quiet, no men.about: as quiet, with No. 1's seven men left out: what they hide (its cart doors shut, its doorway and windows dark), for the behind picture of page 3's slide

slowed.about: No. 2 slowed (8 men waiting, a third of its windows lit, gate half shut, one person left at work in its doorway); No. 1 quiet

w4.about: page 14: No. 2 slowed seen from inside its yard, the 8 men outside its half-shut gate

works-w3-plate.what: W3, the master: No. 1 quiet with its 7 men gathered at the gate, No. 2 flat out with two at work in its doorway

works-w1-plate.what: W1 main: the 7 men waiting at the gate, No. 1's windows dark

works-w1-working-plate.what: W1 helper: the men gone in (two at the looms), No. 1's windows lit, its cart doors open

works-w1-men-gone-plate.what: W1 helper (for page 3's "go"): the men gone in (two at the looms), No. 1's cart doors open, its windows still dark

works-w1-behind-plate.what: W1 helper (for page 3's slide): as the main plate with the 7 men left out, its cart doors shut and windows dark, what the men hide

works-w2-plate.what: W2 main: No. 2 flat out, two at work in its doorway, nobody at the gate

works-w2-slowed-plate.what: W2 helper: No. 2 slowed, 8 men waiting at the gate, one left at work inside, two thirds of its windows dark

works-w4-plate.what: W4: inside No. 2's yard, no men (they are own-surface silhouettes), no gate leaves

state_pictures.about: made from the plates standing in for the paintings, with paper-film/tools/make_state_picture.py (outlines from the shot checker at each plate camera, --fov 64.4); make them again from the paintings once they are approved
state_pictures.works-w1-men-gone-state.png: W1 main plate, with the men-gone helper plate where the men stood, where the cart doorway opened and where two of the men now stand at the looms inside (mask works-w1-men-gone-mask.png, about 12% of the frame, round 5): the time cut on "go"
state_pictures.works-w1-working-state.png: W1 main plate, with the working helper plate wherever they differ (about 74% of the frame: the windows, the doorway and the yard's light on the lane): the blend on "start"
state_pictures.works-w2-slowed-state.png: W2 main plate, with the slowed helper plate where the eight men stand, the windows go dark and one of the two people at work inside goes (about 14% of the frame): page 12
state_pictures.works-w1-behind.png: W1 main plate, with the behind helper plate (the men left out, all else quiet) where the men stood (about 8% of the frame): the behind picture for page 3's slide, so what the men hid is the quiet works (the "men gone" and working pictures have No. 1's doorway or windows lit there)

letter_pixels.about: letter heights on the film's 1080 x 1920 frame at each view's composed spot (letters: gate boards 0.266 and 0.25 m, the bank's sign 0.305 m, PETROL 0.097 m, DIESEL 0.106 m)

works-set-lane.glb.holds: the lane, its terraces and gas lamps, the cross street and the end terrace, the bank, the low walls, the works wall with its piers and gate arches, the dividing wall (the painting is shone onto it)

works-set-factories.glb.holds: the two factories (their window groups, chimney-top markers and cart doors by name)

works-set-props.glb.holds: the props and No. 1's seven waiting men (in the paintings; the men are hidden when they go in)

works-signs.glb.holds: own surfaces: the lettered things (gate boards, drums, the bank's sign and plate)

works-gates.glb.holds: own surfaces, never in a plate: the gate leaves (no-1-gate, no-2-gate) and No. 1's chain (no-1-chain)

works-pop-up.glb.holds: own surfaces, never in a plate: the crates that pop up in No. 1's gateway (no-1-crate-1 to 3)

works-no-2-men.glb.holds: No. 2's eight waiting men: painted in W2's slowed helper plate, dark own-surface silhouettes in W4

works-doorway-workers.glb.holds: the people at work inside the two lit doorways (no-1-worker-1 and 2, no-2-worker-1 and 2): painted into the plates, kept here for the record; the film need not load them
